verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first engine shipped as "just a normal Rust dependency" [bevy-docs-21], and a runtime probe confirms the cargo workflow needs no editor [bevy-probe-rt-2], so command-line builds without clicking through an editor are inherent. The repo also shows examples run from the command line [bevy-gh-2]. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-build documentation, evidence of a per-platform export/packaging workflow (web, mobile, desktop bundles) from the CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
